text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: (Alright! Here is where I make my move—)

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
—I won't let you passsss! 
HAAAAAAAAAH............!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(I'm fine! That was a really solid run. 
I can feel my form improving more and 
more...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: And yet—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
WHOOOOOA...!! 
Titleholder's presence was totally insane, 
weren't it?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously...! 
She's, like, completely 
un-freaking-stoppable!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact was awesome too, but... 
Titleholder has this crazy momentum going, 
like she's right in her absolute prime!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Totally! And Efforia's just getting 
started too, so 
the next era's gonna be so hype!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(—The dream that everyone is looking 
toward... 
I... haven't caught up to it yet.)

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: —Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
I see it now. 
The strength you have right now.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"Never giving up. If your wings won't 
work, 
you fly with your legs... That reckless 
grit."

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"We're... not done yet, 
are we?"

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"We finally met on this turf. 
I want to race against you more."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Mm-hmm. 
Of course."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Let's race again. 
As many times as it takes!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I think I brought out every bit 
of strength I have right now."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes. 
Momentum is truly a terrifying thing, 
isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"While I was struggling to find my 
footing, the buds opened... 
and now, they are in full, glorious 
bloom."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Even so, I—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! 
Excuse me, one second—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Win Marilyn. 
...Are you alright?"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"...Tell me. 
I'm... so weak, aren't I?"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"I got scared. 
...Scared of the new wind blowing past 
me..."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
""No, that's not true! 
You've had your shining moments too. 
You can still do this, Marilyn. You're not 
finished yet—""

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"...Even when I act out lines like that, 
words without a soul behind them... 
fail to resonate."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if I'll ever... 
play the leading role again."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"No! Never... 
That is absolutely not true."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Living things evolve 
in order to adapt to their environment."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"You are still on the turf, Win Marilyn— 
There is bound to be a path where you will 
blossom."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: ...Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... 
your running style looked different 
somehow, didn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I changed it, too. 
—So that I could keep running."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"No. 
So that I could win, with even greater 
strength!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I will never give up. Even against this 
new wind... 
I will adapt, no matter what!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"...Even Daring Tact 
had no choice but to change."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Then... who am I to stay the same? 
...Remember, Marilyn."

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Remember your fighting spirit. 
You have—"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"You've got the guts in ya to never admit 
defeat too, don'tcha, dammit?!"

Daring Tact's form is undeniably on an 
upward trend. 
Even so, the impression remains that the 
new generation 
is taking over...

If that's the case, then right here, once 
again— 
she must assert her presence as a Triple 
Tiara horsegirl. 
Which means the next target is—
choice_data_list: How about the Queen Elizabeth II Cup?

What do you think of the Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup?

text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is an autumn GⅠ 
race 
open to both Classic and Senior runners, 
crowning 
the strongest medium-distance runner on 
the Tiara path.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I agree...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...I can feel it. Next time, I can 
deliver 
my greatest run yet... If so,"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Having returned at the Victoria Mile, 
I will make my true, complete revival 
at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"And show everyone 
an "overwhelmingly strong" me."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I believe that is what everyone 
has been waiting for."

And so, our next goal was set for the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup. 
We'll use the summer training camp to 
build her up 
so she can unleash her absolute peak 
performance there.

Daring Tact's inner strength, and— 
her pride as a Triple Tiara horsegirl. 
Even after injury... that brilliance 
hasn't dimmed in the slightest.

title: After the Takarazuka Kinen: Even in a New Form
